title: Predicting molecular mechanisms of hereditary diseases by using their tissue-selective manifestation
summary: An interpretable tissue-feature ML framework predicts tissue-associated disease genes across 18,927 protein-coding genes and eight tissues and analyzes tissue-selective hereditary disease mechanisms; prediction is supported by held-out disease-gene evaluation and patient-diagnostic analyses. Full Molecular Systems Biology article, Methods and Results, held-out evaluation and diagnostic case analyses inspected.
ai_technology: Interpretable ML combines tissue expression, eQTL, PPI and gene-function features to score tissue-associated disease genes.
